name: Freightliner eCascadia 438 kWh
source_notes: Freightliner eCascadia public spec sheet (438 kWh pack, CCS up to 350 kW). Usable kWh per D-10: ~90% nameplate minus 0.5 kWh BMS reserve. Charge curve breakpoints from OEM CCS taper documentation (D-11).

batteryHealthGuidance.notes: DTNA demo fleet: 1M+ test miles at 2.165 kWh/mi avg at 80k lbs GCW. CARB BEDT avg 2.1 kWh/mi. 438 kWh pack supports 220-230 mi typical port/drayage shifts.

hvip.dealers: Central Coast Truck Center, Daimler Trucks North America LLC, Excel Truck Group, Freightliner Northwest, Fresno Truck Center, Golden Gate Truck Center, LDV, Inc., Lonestar Truck Group, Premier Truck Group of Kansas City, PTG Wisconsin, LLC, Sacramento Truck Center, Southport Truck Group, Truck Country of Iowa, Velocity Truck Centers

carbValidation.testVehicle: TransPower Class 8 drayage prototype @ 72,000 lbs GCW
carbValidation.notes: UCR chassis dynamometer + in-use study at POLB. Loaded to 72,000 lbs (average fully loaded drayage weight). EER = battery electric efficiency vs diesel.
